notes.title: Graphics settings
notes.content:
[p]You have a bad computer! It's no longer a problem! With this new update, you can change the resolution of the game between 3 options: High for computers built for gaming, Medium if you don't have a graphics card, and Low if your computer is a potato.

const PRESETS := {[/p][p]	0: Vector2i(864, 486),   # Low[/p][p]	1: Vector2i(1152, 648),   # Medium[/p][p]	2: Vector2i(2304, 1296)    # High[/p][p]}

These are the three resolutions, and don't worry! The game knows your screen dimensions and will automatically scale to your screen resolution.


Stay tuned for more and have a nice day!
[/p][p]- TOUQUI[/p]

notes.title: Steam Cloud Update
notes.content:
[p]When the game comes out, you will have the possibility to play on different computers with the same save.

The game should be coming at the end of the month or at the start of July.

I also added the possibility to change the wheel color: black and white only.

 Have a nice day! :)

 - TOUQUI[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.9
notes.content:
I just finished making some small adjustments. The game is now entering its final phase. I need to test it a bit more and finish preparing the SteamWorks requirements. After that, the game will finally be available for sale at $0.99 USD. Don't expect too much from this game—it's just a simple drift game like the ones that were available online in 2008. Have a nice day!

- TOUQUI
